crossRefs.note: Blessed is the one whom you choose and cause to come near, that he may live in your courts. We will be filled with the…
For a day in your courts is better than a thousand. I would rather be a doorkeeper in the house of my God, than to…
Return to your rest, my soul, for Yahweh has dealt bountifully with you.
Yahweh is good to those who wait for him, to the soul who seeks him.
It is good that a man should hope and quietly wait for the salvation of Yahweh.
But when he came to himself he said, ‘How many hired servants of my father’s have bread enough to spare, and I’m dying…
Having therefore, brothers, boldness to enter into the holy place by the blood of Jesus,
Draw near to God, and he will draw near to you. Cleanse your hands, you sinners. Purify your hearts, you double-minded.
Because Christ also suffered for sins once, the righteous for the unrighteous, that he might bring you to God, being…
Come and hear, all you who fear God. I will declare what he has done for my soul.
God, you have taught me from my youth. Until now, I have declared your wondrous works.
My tongue will also talk about your righteousness all day long, for they are disappointed, and they are confounded, who…
Let them offer the sacrifices of thanksgiving, and declare his deeds with singing.
I will not die, but live, and declare Yah’s works.

translations.web: But it is good for me to come close to God. I have made the Lord Yahweh my refuge, that I may tell of all your works.
translations.bsb: But as for me, it is good to draw near to God. I have made the Lord GOD my refuge, that I may proclaim all Your works.
translations.kjv: But it is good for me to draw near to God: I have put my trust in the Lord GOD, that I may declare all thy works.
translations.asv: But it is good for me to draw near unto God: I have made the Lord Jehovah my refuge, That I may tell of all thy works. Psalm 74 Maschil of Asaph.
